title: Let Entra Policy Suite write to devices
purpose: Gives the engine identity only what device tagging needs: Device.ReadWrite.All. Nothing else is granted. The grant is read back.
whenToRun: When you turn on device tagging, and Administration > Optional components shows the right as missing.

runAs.name: Privileged Role Administrator (or Global Administrator)
runAs.why: grants the right to a managed identity

runAs.name: Reader
runAs.scope: the Entra Policy Suite resource group

changes.object: app role assignment on the engine identity

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: the install's resource group (found by itself when not given)

readsOnly: Azure: the engine identity's object id
Graph: the engine identity's app role and directory role assignments
whatIf: What the engine has, and what would be granted; nothing is changed.
